description: This file is a PHP source file containing a test class PersonModuleCest used for acceptance testing of the Person module in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It includes setup/teardown methods and many test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, deleting, and importing records via vCard, specific to the Person module.

classes.name: PersonModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Person module with multiple test scenarios.

methods.description: Setup method to initialize fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.description: Test creating a new person module.

methods.name: testScenarioViewPersonTestModule
methods.description: Test viewing the person module after deployment.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateRecord
